summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Telefônica Brasil S.A. reporting the approval at an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting of the merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Óptica S.A. into the parent. The merger is effective August 1, 2026, with no capital increase, no new share issuance, no change in shareholding structure, no exchange ratio, and no withdrawal rights. This is an intra-group restructuring of a wholly-owned subsidiary, not a special situation with external deal terms, premium, or strategic alternative. No advisors or additional commercial terms were disclosed. Watch for future operational updates, but no risk-arb angle exists.
